meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Signal 收发消息，支持私聊和群聊，处理 Markdown 格式、引用回复、打字指示等。
howto.when: 当用户向绑定的 Signal 号码发送消息时触发。需要先完成注册和授权配置。

say.text: 帮我查一下明天的天气
say.note: Claude 会通过 Signal 回复天气信息。

say.text: 在群里提醒大家下午开会
say.note: Claude 会在群聊中发送提醒。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages via Signal, supporting DMs and group chats, with Markdown formatting, quoted replies, typing indicators, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends a message to the linked Signal number. Requires prior registration and credential setup.

say_en.note: Claude will reply via Signal with weather info.

say_en.text: Remind everyone in the group about the meeting this afternoon.
say_en.note: Claude will send a reminder in the group chat.
